purpose: Turn careers interest into applications: list every open role grouped by team, with a sticky team index for jumping, each row linking straight to its external posting.

behaviour.note: Two-column layout from md: a sticky Teams index on the left (each item jumps to that team's anchor) and the grouped lists on the right. Each team block has an anchor id with scroll-margin-top 8rem so the jump clears the sticky header. The section itself is anchored at #openings, which other sections link to.

Each job row is a bordered line with title, location and a chevron chip; the whole row is a link via a stretched pseudo-element on the title link. Links leave the site to the applicant tracking board in a new tab.
Data is a static snapshot of the job board: 7 teams and 25 jobs counted from jobs.js (the inventory said 21). Rows are real postings; do not invent roles, locations or posting ids.
Last section before the footer on /careers.

label.note: Eyebrow label with an icon. Observed 2 words.

teamsLabel.note: Heading above the sticky team index.

id.note: Anchor slug used by the team index.

postingId.note: Posting id appended to the job board base URL; real value from the source, not invented.

boardBaseUrl.note: Base URL for posting links (external hosted job board).

motion.reducedMotionNote: No animation: anchor jumps and a CSS sticky index only; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.

changes.change: team index is hidden; lists take the full width
